verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's AI agent takes a natural-language description of what you need, then searches, navigates and retrieves it without URLs. It also exposes a setting for how much reasoning the agent spends, which implies goal-directed gathering that ends when the task is satisfied. The standard crawl endpoint, by contrast, is documented as crawling an entire site, and nothing explicitly describes a sufficiency-based stopping mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of adaptive crawl termination based on information sufficiency, details of how stopping criteria or confidence thresholds work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
